caption:
18. the year the life i was handed stopped fitting.

nothing broke on the outside. something cracked on the inside.

where are you on the timeline? comment your age 👇

slides.image: alone empty gym single light start

slides.text:
on paper, i was fine.
training. school. friends.

but every rep felt like
running from something.

i didn't have words for it yet.
just a quiet: this isn't it.

the mirror showed the body i built.
not the person inside it.

that's the crack.
it doesn't break you.
it lets the light in.
